name: Self-hosting
detail: If it can run on my own hardware, it probably does. One Proxmox host, around 15 services, and a list of things I still want to try.

name: Local LLMs
detail: Running language models at home to learn how inference actually works under the hood.

name: Hardware tinkering
detail: Arduino and ESP32 builds and sensor experiments. The Doppler radar started as one of those.

name: Web & mobile development
detail: Most of what I build ends up as a React site or a React Native app. I like the point where a rough idea becomes something you can actually tap on.
